assessment.nobel_worthiness: Palladium-catalyzed C-N coupling made aryl amines routinely accessible and is used daily in pharmaceutical, agrochemical and materials synthesis. Originality is clear: a general catalytic route replacing harsh classical aminations, with ligand design that explains the scope. Few synthetic methods have comparable breadth of real use.
assessment.attribution: Kosugi reported the early tin-amide coupling; Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the amine-based, ligand-enabled catalytic versions that made it general. Three names fit the history, but how to weigh Kosugi's precursor against the two later developers is a judgement call.
assessment.maturity: Decades of independent validation and industrial use; the mechanism and ligand generations are well understood. If anything recognition is overdue, since the closely related Pd cross-coupling prize was awarded in 2010.
uncertainties: Weight of Kosugi's precursor versus the later general methods
Possible overlap with the 2010 cross-coupling prize in the minds of some members

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskites turned a tunable, solution-processed crystalline semiconductor into a photovoltaic absorber with efficiencies rivalling silicon in little over a decade. As a structural chemist I value that the compositional and structural flexibility of the perovskite framework is what enables the property tuning. The impact on energy materials research is very large.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka reported the first perovskite-sensitized cells; Park demonstrated the solid-state, stable, higher-efficiency device; Snaith showed the efficient thin-film and meso-superstructured cells. Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis also made important contributions, so the three-person limit forces difficult exclusions.
assessment.maturity: Efficiency is established and independently reproduced, but long-term operational stability, lead toxicity and manufacturing scale-up are unresolved. Recognition may be somewhat early for commercial impact, though scientific impact is already secure.
uncertainties: Stability and commercialization are not settled
Fair division of credit among at least six contributors
Whether the prize should rest on chemistry of the materials or on device physics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Surfactant-templated ordered mesoporous silica opened pore sizes between zeolites and amorphous solids and founded the field of designed mesostructured materials, with consequences for catalysis, adsorption and nanocasting. The concept of cooperative templating is original and the structural characterization is convincing.
assessment.attribution: The Mobil group (Kresge, Beck) reported MCM-41, while Inagaki and colleagues made FSM-16 in parallel; Stucky, Zhao and Ryoo extended the concept to larger pores and more robust structures (SBA-15, MCM-48 and carbon replicas). Credit is spread across several groups and I am not certain who should be included over Beck or Zhao.
assessment.maturity: The structural chemistry is mature and extensively confirmed by diffraction and electron microscopy. Applications in catalysis are modest compared with zeolites, which tempers the case.
uncertainties: Allocation among Mobil, Japanese and Santa Barbara groups
Scale of practical application is less than the scientific influence

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rational design of zeolites and molecular sieves, with new framework topologies, structure-directing agents and engineered active sites, underlies major refining, petrochemical and emissions-control processes. The impact is large and the link between framework structure and function is exactly the kind of chemistry that matters in practice.
assessment.attribution: Corma, Davis and Zones each made decisive contributions to new frameworks, templating strategies and catalytic design, while Yu and Tsapatsis are also credited for new materials and membranes/nanosheets. Structure determination of new zeolites often relied on others' methods, which does not affect the prize case.
assessment.maturity: Long-established and industrially validated. Because the field is broad, there is risk the prize would be seen as diffuse rather than tied to one discovery.
uncertainties: The discovery is a family of advances rather than a single event
Choice of three among five credited names
Overlap with earlier porous-materials recognition

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carbon nanotubes created a new class of one-dimensional carbon nanostructures with remarkable mechanical and electronic properties, and electron microscopy was central to their recognition. The scientific influence on nanoscience is large, although real-world applications have been slower than predicted.
assessment.attribution: Iijima's 1991 electron microscopy of multiwalled tubes drew the field's attention; Iijima and Bethune independently reported single-walled tubes in 1993; Endo made earlier growth observations of fibres. Priority claims by earlier observers add dispute over who first discovered them.
assessment.maturity: Thoroughly confirmed and mature. Application impact is still mixed, and the prize could be seen as better suited to physics, but the chemistry of synthesis and structure is real.
uncertainties: Earlier observations of hollow carbon filaments complicate priority
Mixed commercial outcomes
Field boundary between chemistry and physics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography at X-ray free-electron lasers enables structure determination from micro- and nanocrystals and time-resolved studies of reactions at room temperature, avoiding much radiation damage. As a crystallographer working on tiny crystals I see this as a genuinely enabling method, though it parallels what electron diffraction does for even smaller crystals.
assessment.attribution: Chapman led the proof-of-principle experiments; Fromme and Hajdu were central to the early photosystem I and method concepts; Schlichting contributed to the mechanistic time-resolved work. The credit assignment among these is not trivial.
assessment.maturity: The method is demonstrated and now used for mechanistic studies, but the number of facilities is small and the range of scientifically decisive results is still growing. Recognition may be slightly early.
uncertainties: Accessibility is limited to few facilities
Relationship to the earlier 3D electron diffraction and microcrystal methods
Which of four contributors to include

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Single-atom catalysts push dispersion to the atomic limit and make active sites structurally definable, which links directly to the structure-function questions in heterogeneous catalysis. The concept has stimulated a very large literature and new characterization needs.
assessment.attribution: The 2011 Pt1/FeOx work by Qiao, Wang, Liu, Zhang and coworkers is the usual reference point, with Datye and Li contributing to characterization and theory. Because the term reappears in earlier surface-science work, attribution of the concept is arguable.
assessment.maturity: The field is young compared with other candidates, and its evidence is based largely on microscopy and X-ray absorption, where claims about truly isolated sites can be overstated. Stability and industrial relevance are still developing.
uncertainties: Rigor of structural evidence varies across the literature
Premature relative to older candidates
Precedent in earlier supported single-atom work

assessment.nobel_worthiness: MXenes are a large, compositionally tunable family of two-dimensional carbides and nitrides made by selective etching of MAX phases, with promising uses in energy storage and electronics. A new materials family with systematic chemistry is the kind of discovery I value.
assessment.attribution: Naguib, Gogotsi and Barsoum published the original Ti3C2 work in 2011, and the group credit is clear and compact.
assessment.maturity: Quite recent, with most applications still at the laboratory stage. The structural characterization of surface terminations is incomplete, which argues for waiting.
uncertainties: Termination chemistry is not fully resolved
Commercial impact not yet demonstrated
Early relative to the older candidates
